situation: I send a message and the person doesn't reply within an hour
behavior: I assume they're busy and move on with my day

situation: My boss schedules a meeting without explaining the topic
behavior: I show up curious and let the meeting clarify itself

situation: I make a small mistake at work that nobody noticed
behavior: I make a mental note for next time and let it go

situation: Someone gives me ambiguous feedback like 'interesting'
behavior: I take it at face value and ask what they mean if I want more

situation: I wake up with a slight headache
behavior: I drink some water and get on with my morning

situation: A friend cancels plans last minute
behavior: I use the unexpected free time for something I enjoy

situation: I am stuck in unexpected traffic
behavior: I put on a podcast and accept I'll get there when I get there

situation: I have to give a short presentation tomorrow
behavior: I jot down a couple of bullet points and sleep normally
I say thanks and take it as kindness rather than read into it

situation: My phone battery dies while I'm out
behavior: I shrug and enjoy not being reachable for a few hours
